## Context / Problem
`src/rebar/_engine` no longer holds a Python package; `git ls-tree` at origin/main dcb35ce77fe lists only `jira-capability-probe.py` and `resources/`. Even so, several tests still put it on `sys.path` before importing `rebar.reducer` or `rebar.graph`, which resolve through the installed package anyway:
- `tests/scripts/reducer/test_reducer_file_impact.py:14-16`
- `tests/scripts/reducer/test_reducer_links.py:487-489`
- `tests/scripts/reducer/test_reducer_reduce_all.py:153-155`
- `tests/scripts/reducer/test_ticket_llm_format.py:9-10`
- `tests/scripts/reducer/test_ticket_reducer_llm_format.py:10`
- `tests/scripts/graph/test_graph_cycles.py:275-277`
- the unused `_SCRIPTS_DIR` definition in `tests/scripts/conftest.py:27-28`

These inserts are dead. They also keep the old by-path engine-loader shape alive in the test tree. Epic friended-brainsick-degus removed the reconciler's own copies; these target the reducer and graph and were outside that epic's scope.

The docstrings of `engine_on_path()` in `tests/external/live_jira_cloud_mutation/_cloud_mutation_support.py:21-26` and `tests/external/live_jira_cloud_s3/_cloud_s3_support.py:76-82` describe putting `_engine` on `sys.path`, but both function bodies are empty.

## Approach
Delete each insert and its path constant, and keep the imports that follow. Reword or delete the 2 `engine_on_path()` no-ops and their callers. Before deleting anything, confirm with `git grep` that no test still needs a module that lives only under `_engine`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git grep -nE '"_engine"\)|/ "_engine"' -- tests ':!tests/fixtures'` prints nothing.
- [ ] `pytest tests/scripts/reducer tests/scripts/graph -q` passes.
- [ ] [non-codebase] `make verify` exits 0.
